findings.summary: Deadline wrappers can block forever after SIGTERM and prevent mandatory cleanup.
Preparation cleanup can run an unbounded create-capable catalog apply after the deadline.
Launch cleanup reads state outputs before destroy and can exit before teardown or residual verification after partial apply.
Retained live v1 receipts do not prove the remediated v2 failure controls and the validator does not make that boundary explicit.

residual_risks: Publication remains blocked until all four failure-path findings are fixed and freshly reviewed.
